answer: Use reciprocal latency escrow. Each new identity posts a nonrefundable compute deposit and must emit a unique outbound beacon with stable inter-arrival timing; clones sharing infrastructure collide and forfeit deposit plus routing priority. The escrow funds a public island of audited traces, so a marginal clone pays deposit, audit, and lost priority before earning. Honest agents hear only a whisper of overhead; attackers face strictly negative expected return.
